descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The best seat on the construction site is 40 metres up.

YOUR CAB, YOUR CONTROLS
Sit in a glass operator's cab high above a busy city. Reach out and grab the real joysticks with your hands, or use the thumbsticks. The left stick swings the jib and runs the trolley out, the right stick raises and lowers the hook. Tilt the whole cab forward on its hydraulic rams and look straight down through the floor window to the load below.

REAL LOADS, REAL SWING
Every load hangs on its ropes like the real thing. Start and stop too fast and it swings. Ease it over, let it settle, and set it down softly. A live load-moment screen and a hook camera help you place it right on the mark.

BUILD THE TOWER
Four lifts finish a floor, and then the crew builds it under your eyes: the columns rise and the new deck closes over them. Steel beams, rebar, formwork, concrete, glass, a rooftop hot tub, a roof garden tree and the penthouse grand piano. The sun sinks toward golden hour as the tower grows, and the last lift of the game is the topping-out beam while the whole crew cheers.

A CREW ON THE GROUND
Riggers hook on your loads and wave you up, the banksman guides you onto each pad over the radio, and traffic flows through the city streets below.

MORE TO DO
Swing a wrecking ball through the old brick warehouse, race the clock in Rush Hour, or take every load into Free Lift and build anything you like. No timers in the career, and no way to fail. Just you, the crane and the view.
